identification: 2016 Holden Barina CD 5-door automatic hatch, white, 27,377 km, unregistered (rego expired 5 Jul 2026), account trustees sale (15 photos viewed).

entries.note: Seven 2016 Barina CD listings, all with 96,000-169,000 km, so kms are roughly a quarter of ours; asking, not sold

viewing_check: Armitage est $3,000-4,000, bid $2,400. Very low kms for age, so likely to beat the dealer asks above (A$5.5-10k at 100k+ km plus govt charges). Needs rego, roadworthy, check for service history and keys. Buyer premium 22% on $2,400 is $2,928 total. Compare carsales for sold prices before bidding.
searches_tried: Terapeak is not suited to cars. WebSearch carsales/carsguide 2016 Barina CD; fetched carsguide listing page.
flip_reason: Car, not a quick flip. Trade resale looks strong (low kms) but needs transport, rego and time.
